args.actionGone: action is gone. What a part does is written as a flow. A flow is a container card: put node cards inside it and join them with lines: begin (kind: begin; trigger: receive to receive) → process (kind: process; rows of read, write, sign, verify, call, send, receive and compute in steps; where a row reads and writes, the lines reads and writes) → end (kind: end; what it returns in return), joined by next lines. Calling another flow and waiting for it to end is a run (kind: run and the line runs). The shape is in guide with about: flow. For example (one call with card_create's target left out and value given by path): {"Behavior:Order": {"kind": "flow"}, "Behavior:Order.start": {"kind": "begin", "trigger": "receive", "program": "Claude Code", "carries": ["Data:Order"], "connections": [{"line": "next", "to": "work"}]}, "Behavior:Order.work": {"kind": "process", "steps": [{"do": "read"}, {"do": "write"}], "connections": [{"line": "reads", "from": "steps[0]", "to": "Data:Order"}, {"line": "writes", "from": "steps[1]", "to": "Data:Order", "at": "total"}, {"line": "next", "to": "done"}]}, "Behavior:Order.done": {"kind": "end", "outcome": "success", "return": {"carries": ["Data:Order.total"]}}}
args.oldClauses: clauses (a note's clauses) are gone. A document written with items and rows is a kind: formatdoc card's rows; a note and a freedoc have only body (the shape is in guide with about: rows)
args.pairsValueShape: Without target, value is an object by path (value.{key} is not an object)
args.targetListShape: A target array lists one or more non-empty strings
args.targetNeededForPairs: target is required (to pass different values at once, leave target out and make value an object by path)
args.targetOne: This tool takes one target (not an array)
args.targetType: target is a string or an array of strings
args.valueObject: value is an object (its shape is in guide)
args.valueShape: (the shape of value is in guide with about: {tool})
